event.text: Self-care at home is reasonable right now — a 2-day runny nose and mild sore throat with no fever and normal eating and drinking don't need a clinician visit or medicine. Rest and keep fluids up. If you develop trouble breathing or can't swallow or manage your saliva, call 911 or go to an emergency department immediately — don't wait for a message reply. Separately, if symptoms clearly worsen at any point, or if they persist without improving beyond about ten days, arrange clinician assessment (urgent care if messaging isn't available).
